subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Billing System
body: Dear valued customer, We are pleased to inform you about the upcoming changes to our billing system that will simplify your payment process. Starting next month, you will notice a new layout and improved functionality in your online account. These changes will make it easier for you to track your invoices and manage your payments efficiently. We appreciate your continued support and look forward to providing you with an enhanced billing experience. For any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you.
